entities.name: End of Diraden's Eternal Night
entities.description: Event that returned Diraden's non-black mana after decades of eternal night.

entities.name: Diraden
entities.description: Plane trapped in eternal night by Velrav's curse.

entities.name: Velrav
entities.description: Prince whose plane-spanning curse caused the eternal night; wanted to become a planeswalker.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who unlocked her red mana and beheaded Velrav.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker and hieromancer who allied with Chandra.

entities.name: Jurl
entities.description: Goblin who led Gideon and Chandra to Falia's village.

entities.name: Falia
entities.description: Wise woman who schemed to have Chandra imprisoned.

entities.name: King Gelidor
entities.description: Velrav's imprisoned, withered father whose blood sustained the eternal night.

entities.name: Fog Riders
entities.description: Velrav's riders, one of whom Gideon killed.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Plane Chandra and Gideon headed for.

events.summary: Chandra and Gideon arrive on Diraden and, though enemies, band together to end the curse.
events.quote: they decided to band together to end the curse so they could escape the plane

events.summary: Jurl leads them to Falia's village; Falia schemes against Chandra, and Gideon kills a Fog Rider before being captured.
events.quote: killing one of Velrav's Fog Riders before he too was taken captive

events.summary: Gideon is tied up for blooddrinkers to feed on; Chandra parleys with Velrav to treat him with mercy in exchange for the truth of planeswalkers.
events.quote: she parleyed with Velrav to treat Gideon with more mercy

events.summary: Velrav plans a blood ritual to become a planeswalker; Chandra and Gideon deal with King Gelidor to trick Velrav into killing his father, but are found out.
events.quote: They were found out, however, and their plan was foiled.

events.summary: Chandra unlocks red mana, creates a fire sword and beheads Velrav; Gelidor impales himself on it, lifting the curse.
events.quote: Chandra created a sword of fire and beheaded the prince before he could kill Gideon.

events.summary: Diraden's night fades; Chandra and Gideon leave for Regatha.
events.quote: Chandra and Gideon left the plane shortly afterwards, heading for Regatha .

relations.note: Beheaded him with a fire sword.
relations.quote: Chandra created a sword of fire and beheaded the prince before he could kill Gideon.
